name: markitdown-ui
description: Typora-style file-to-Markdown converter with LLM enhancement
author: JJCKA

scripts.build:backend: MDGUI\Scripts\python.exe -m PyInstaller --onefile --name markitdown-backend --distpath release --workpath build\pyinstaller --specpath build --collect-all magika --collect-all onnxruntime --collect-all markitdown --collect-all mammoth --collect-all pdfminer --collect-all openpyxl --collect-all beautifulsoup4 --collect-all pydub --collect-all speechrecognition --collect-all python-docx --collect-all python-pptx --collect-all pdfplumber --collect-all pandas --collect-all pillow --collect-all cryptography --hidden-import comtypes --hidden-import fastapi --hidden-import uvicorn --hidden-import httpx --hidden-import pydantic --hidden-import starlette --additional-hooks-dir scripts\pyinstaller-hooks --runtime-hook scripts\pyinstaller-hooks\runtime-hooks.py backend\main.py
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run build:installer
